meta.description: Build, evaluate, and audit right-censored or competing-risk survival workflows with scikit-survival, including leakage-safe preprocessing, model selection, probability prediction, and censoring-aware metrics. Provides comprehensive guidance on Cox PH, survival trees/forests, and proper evaluation with time-dependent metrics.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of scikit-survival capabilities with proper disclaimers against clinical advice claims

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for survival analysis with explicit warnings: 'Do not present model output as clinical advice, causal evidence, or proof of clinical utility'

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established survival analysis methods with comprehensive non-negotiable workflow preventing data leakage

code_usability.detail: Code examples are syntactically correct with proper leakage-safe pipeline patterns

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of survival workflows: Cox PH, forests, boosting, SVMs, competing risks, time-dependent prediction, censoring-aware metrics

reliability.note: Exceptional reliability with 10-point non-negotiable workflow preventing common pitfalls (leakage, metric misuse, competing risk errors)

performance_context.note: Well-organized with scope statement, current release details, workflow checklist, bundled CLIs mentioned

agent_usability.note: Outstanding with non-negotiable workflow, estimand definition requirement, leakage prevention, metric matching guidance

human_usability.note: Clear installation with Python 3.11+, pinned dependencies, uv venv setup, GPL-3.0 upstream license noted

security.note: Excellent security with local-only processing, bundled CLIs network-free by default, clinical advice disclaimer

maintainability.note: Version 1.1, MIT license (skill), GPL-3.0-or-later upstream noted, verified 2026-07-23, scikit-survival 0.28.0 documented

agent_specific.note: Strong with clear scope, non-negotiable workflow, leakage-safe patterns; minor: competing-risk workflow examples limited
